name: Darling Data Performance Monitor Lite
free_limit: Free MIT-licensed local desktop application for on-demand SQL Server and Azure SQL monitoring, including collectors, alerts, query analysis and local DuckDB/Parquet storage; no software subscription, per-server quota or expiry stated.
watch_out: Lite runs on a Windows workstation and monitors existing SQL Server instances remotely; it does not include SQL Server, Azure/RDS database resources or hosting. Monitoring credentials need VIEW SERVER STATE permission. Paid support is optional; Darling continuous-collection edition is a separate deployment model.
